question: Maple Leaf Gardens opened 95 years ago today, Nov. 12, 1931, before a record 13,233 fans. In the middle of the Great Depression, how long did it take to build?
question_short: Toronto's Maple Leaf Gardens opened Nov. 12, 1931. How long did it take to build?
answer_detail: Ground broke June 1, 1931. Crews worked three eight-hour shifts a day, and to cover a $200,000 funding gap, workers took 20% of their pay in Gardens stock.
answer_short: Ground broke June 1, 1931; crews worked around the clock in three shifts.
